handlers.name: init_mobile
handlers.source_obligation: Calls setupMobile, wires source load pointer/touch/click handlers, probes async save availability, starts update RAF and exposes QA helpers.
handlers.first_person_equivalent: Split obligations: coarse-touch excluded; actual Remember/load and storage failure UI retained; SceneTree replaces RAF; isolated QA harness replaces source window._rb inspection.
handlers.acceptance: Real native/Web cold title, save-present/missing/refused load and continue/fresh. Document source hidden-load button versus3D always-available Remember error behavior. Never blanket-exclude this mixed handler as mobile.

handlers.name: setupMobile
handlers.source_obligation: Entire setup is gated on pointer:coarse: analog touch stick, touch action buttons/title forwarding, touch cook lock and gesture suppression.
handlers.first_person_equivalent: Keyboard/mouse Windows and browser controls are selected. No virtual stick, touch chrome or mobile acceptance is claimed.
handlers.acceptance: Ratified target decision plus source gate proof. Desktop attack/interact/cook/menu functions still require their normal target evidence; lack of mobile UI is not a reason to fabricate a parallel mechanic.

handlers.name: titleLoadTap
handlers.source_obligation: Prevent propagation/default, invoke loadFromTitle once from the title load button.
handlers.first_person_equivalent: FullScene title Remember button routes once into its real asynchronous load path; fresh/cancel/late-result guards remain.
handlers.acceptance: Normal native/Web click with save present/absent/refused, one load transaction, fresh-session callback isolation and resumed controls; not a mobile-only exclusion.

handlers.name: drawPlayerContactShadow
handlers.source_obligation: Source top-down player-foot soft contact blob.
handlers.first_person_equivalent: Arms-only first-person body is not rendered. Viewmodel shadows are disabled; world/NPC shadows remain. Ratify absence of a fabricated disembodied player-foot blob.
handlers.acceptance: Native/Web low-rest/attack/kick/cart views establish no floating fist shadow. This is an explicit missing-body adaptation, not a claim that source player-foot shadow exists.

handlers.name: drawAll
handlers.source_obligation: Source render/visual-clock compositor including world, actors, particles, shake, overlays, maps and cooking; child calls are not one interchangeable operation.
handlers.first_person_equivalent: FullScene and original presenters compose perspective geometry, lighting, UI and overlays with declared source clock adaptations.
handlers.acceptance: Union all observable source render sub-obligations and their native/Web evidence. Current world-feedback/impact-shake and ambient dust/mote drafts are not yet production integration; retain partial until accepted. Explicit body/pixel/touch dispositions cannot conceal these real remaining visual gaps.

handlers.name: init_frame
handlers.source_obligation: Empty exported function body in active source.
handlers.first_person_equivalent: No independent runtime action to port; frame composition remains a separate drawAll obligation.
handlers.acceptance: Hash/AST proof of empty body and explicit approved no-op disposition. No invented screenshot or side effect; source-body change invalidates the proof.

handlers.name: makeRoutePatch32
handlers.source_obligation: Authored32x32 tier1–4 route patch rendered over the player chest; tier=min(4,floor(routesCompleted/5)).
handlers.first_person_equivalent: Chest is outside the arm-only camera. Keep source route count/progression/Office unlock and reachable FILED journal; no floating badge or relocated wrist patch.
handlers.acceptance: Explicitly accept unseen chest-art omission and retain actual route progression/journal evidence. Legacy helper requires current-cache call-site proof, not a false alias or independent rendered badge.
